messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: runtime-prod (us-west) pool gpu-7 experiencing sustained queue growth. queue_length=2500+, p95_latency=2.1s, error_rate=4.6%. See: https://monitoring/reports/alert/26350
Alex T.: I'm taking pager. Mira/Jordan can you confirm scope? customer impact or runtime regression?
Mira C.: looking at traces now. KV cache miss rate spiked ~60%. Many requests are long token sequences (>=8k) and batching is causing big prefixes. Not seeing OOMs.
Jordan P.: prelim: mix of a few heavy customers + a small regression in async-kernel scheduling that increased tail latency. Immediate mitigations:
  1) lower max_inflight on gpu-7 nodes to 8 (was 20) to reduce queuing pressure
  2) reduce request timeout to 30s (was 60s) to fail fast and free slots
  3) enable priority-shedding for free-tier + non-authenticated traffic
  4) temporarily disable non-essential streaming (non-admin) to reduce connection churn
Commands I'll run in sequence (preview):
```
# patch configmap / runtime-config
kubectl -n runtime patch configmap runtime-pool-gpu-7 -p '{"data":{"max_inflight":"8","request_timeout":"30s","enable_streaming":"false"}}'
# enable shedding flag
redis-cli -h config-store HSET runtime:flags priority_shed:true
# apply per-tenant rate limits (15m)
/admin rate-limit set tenant:acme 10r/s
/admin rate-limit set tenant:bluebox 8r/s
```
Alex T.: OK Jordan, apply patches. I'll coordinate support comms. I'm going to ack PD and note mitigations. /pd ack 2635037890
ops-sre-bot: PD incident 2635037890 acknowledged by Alex T.
Jordan P.: Applied config patches to gpu-7 pool (rolling across 4 nodes). Rate limits applied to acme, bluebox, testinc for 15m. Enabled priority_shed=true.
Mira C.: Monitoring: queue_length -> 2500 -> 600 in 90s after changes, p95 latency down ~40%, error_rate trending down. Streaming connections dropped ~30%.
Liz H.: Support: started outreach to top impacted customers (acme/bluebox). Noting increased 429s for free-tier — expected. Posting customer note in #support-status.
Alex T.: Good. Plan: keep these mitigations for 15m, observe 10m stable window, then gradually relax (increase max_inflight to 12, restore streaming for admins). If regressions return, we'll roll back to the conservative state and engage runtime-ml for kernel fallback.
Mira C.: Agreed. I'll keep a watch on KV hit-rate and kernel latencies. If KV misses stay high, suggest enabling short-term prefix caching for heavy tenants.
Jordan P.: Logging action items in incident tracker and created runbook checkpoint: https://incidents/2635037890/action (includes commands ran + diff).
Alex T.: Handoff: I'll stay 15m then hand to night-oncall. @ops-sre-bot please remind night oncall at +30m. :thumbsup:
ops-sre-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2635038070 to notify night-oncall.
Liz H.: Noted. Final note: support slack msg posted, customers acknowledged; no SLO burns expected if trends continue.
Alex T.: Closing loop: will update incident ticket with mitigation timeline + rollback plan. Thanks all — good quick coordination. :eyes:
